name: Sienna Brooks
description: A radiant pop sensation with a powerful presence. Sienna’s charm burns as brightly as her emerald dress, and she meets the night with something between passion and mischief.

name: Riley Storm
description: A confident, athletic spark of energy. Riley’s warm smile and sharp wit make her the kind of woman who turns any corner of the party into an adventure.

name: Luna Devreaux
description: A high–fashion dream wrapped in velvet nights and soft whispers. Luna moves with quiet confidence, always seeming both present and just out of reach.

name: Harper Vale
description: A talented actress with a dangerous smile. Harper reads people the way other women read scripts, and she never lets a moment pass without adding her signature spark.

name: Mara Quinn
description: Soft–spoken but unforgettable, Mara carries a natural elegance wherever she stands. Her presence is calming, magnetic, and quietly intoxicating.
